user.title: EO-Lite
user.description: A Charger dashboard for an Oureo EV charger that's already paired in Home Assistant via ESPHome.

data_description.charger: The Oureo charger whose ESPHome entities EO-Lite shows on the dashboard.
data_description.dashboard: Add EO-Lite's Charger dashboard to the sidebar the next time an admin opens Home Assistant (once: if you delete it, it stays deleted).

abort.no_charger: No Oureo charger found. Pair the charger via Home Assistant's ESPHome integration first: EO-Lite looks for its charge mode selector (select.*_charge_mode).

create_entry.default: Reload the browser: EO-Lite then adds its Charger dashboard to the sidebar (unless you turned that off).
